name: open_sub_account
description: Look up a member, read their savings balance, and open a new sub-account for them.

discovery.sourceGoal: Log into the teller console (username "teller", password "[REDACTED]"). Then look up member 10023, extract their current savings balance as "savingsBalance", then open a new "share" sub-account for them with nickname "Holiday Fund" and an initial deposit of 50. Once you reach the confirmation screen, extract the confirmation number as "confirmationNumber", then finish successfully.

outputs.name: savingsBalance
outputs.description: Member's savings balance read before opening the sub-account.

outputs.name: confirmationNumber
outputs.description: Confirmation number of the newly opened sub-account.
